description: FREE (key) to hand over — records of a list shared with you go to one of the workspace's pipelines you may use (describe_list names them: HubSpot, Slack, lemlist …). The pipeline's data check and release apply: a manual one waits for a person; one that sends by itself delivers at once and its per-record price counts on this key's day budget. Up to 500 per call.
